leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement useDeferredValue to defer state updates for non-urgent UI rendering
Configure a deferred value to improve performance during rapid input changes
Integrate useDeferredValue with input components to manage user interactions
Render deferred values alongside regular state values in React components
Manipulate component rendering priorities using deferred value patterns
Construct a search interface that utilizes deferred values for filtering operations
Control UI responsiveness by applying deferred updates to computationally expensive operations
